user.title: Connect to myPPC
user.description: The integration stores your credentials locally and reads the portal daily at 08:00 in the Home Assistant time zone. Chromium and chromedriver must already be available in the Home Assistant environment; see the README. The payment code is optional if there is only one consumption point.

reauth_confirm.title: Reauthenticate myPPC
reauth_confirm.description: Enter the credentials for the same account. They are checked against the portal before being saved. The payment code and history are kept.

error.invalid_auth: Incorrect or missing username or password
error.invalid_code: The payment code must contain only digits
error.cannot_connect: The portal could not confirm login. Saved credentials were not changed.
error.browser_unavailable: Chromium and chromedriver must already be installed in the Home Assistant environment. See the README.
error.wrong_account: Use the same account as the existing integration
